items.title: Flintoff hits 65-ball ton as Lancashire set up quarter-final vs Stokes' Durham
items.description: Rocky Flintoff made his first Lancashire century in a One Day Cup thrashing of Somerset - and will now meet Ben Stokes and Durham in the quarter-finals.

items.title: Floodlights to be on throughout Hundred matches for solar eclipse
items.description: Floodlights will be turned on throughout games in The Hundred on Wednesday due to the solar eclipse.

items.title: Jaissle 'bit scared' how refs will take 'emotional' touchline style

items.title: Women's football shouldn't be penalised by Uefa boycott - Nandy
items.description: Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy says women's footballers should not be "penalised" by a potential boycott of next month's Under-20 Women's World Cup.

items.title: SunRisers beat Super Giants to reach Hundred eliminator
items.description: Reigning champions SunRisers Leeds snatched a spot in the women's Hundred eliminator by beating Manchester Super Giants by 41 runs in a winner-takes-all game at Old Trafford.

items.title: Levy goes up against Spurs owners to buy London's NBA Europe team
items.description: Former Tottenham chairman Daniel Levy is vying with a consortium including current Spurs' owners, the Lewis family, to buy NBA Europe's London-based team.

items.title: Unbeaten star Bow Echo in shock retirement after setback
items.description: Bow Echo has been retired from racing after the shock news that George Boughey's unbeaten star has suffered a setback in training.
